caseName: Bureau of Economic Analysis v. Long
caseNameFull: Bureau of Economic Analysis, United States Department of Commerce v. Long

opinions.text: Application for stay, presented to Justice Stevens, and by him referred to the Court, granted. The order of the United States District Court for the Western District of Washington, filed January 12, 1981, is stayed pending disposition of the appeal currently pending before the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit.
